about.en: Manyu (MANYU) is a community memecoin on Ethereum named after Manyu, a dog popular on social media. It is the ERC-20 token at 0x95AF4aF910c28E8EcE4512BFE46F1F33687424ce with 9 decimals and a fixed supply of one quadrillion tokens; it has no protocol or claim behind it. Several unrelated tokens also use the MANYU ticker on other chains.
